stem: A water hose discharges water at a rate of 45 gallons per minute. Which graph has a slope that best represents this rate?

options.label: F
options.text: Graph with a steep line reaching about 150 gallons at approximately 3 minutes.

options.label: H
options.text: Graph with a horizontal line at 45 gallons, across all 10 minutes.

options.label: G
options.text: Graph with a line from 0 gallons at 0 minutes to 150 gallons at 10 minutes.

options.label: J
options.text: Graph with a line less steep than F, reaching about 90 gallons by 3 minutes.

visual_elements: Four line graphs labeled F, H, G, and J showing amount of water (gallons) versus time (minutes) with different slopes.
